name: wp-seo-shapes
description: File checks over a baked WordPress site running an SEO plugin (Yoast-shaped). The collision the PRD names: an SEO plugin and a theme/plugin both emit head SEO, so description / og:title ship twice with different values, and the JSON-LD schema graph ships twice. Also the attachment trap: WordPress attachment pages (when they render at all) inherit the front page canonical and are left indexable, and a paginated archive whose canonical points at page 1 de-indexes its own page 2. Zero network, zero HTML execution - attribute reads only.
